nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text: Sri Lanka’s Health Minister, Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa, confirmed in Parliament that no recent cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) have been detected in the country.

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
He reassured the public that the Health Ministry remains vigilant, with 20 designated testing locations in place to monitor for potential cases. 
A suspected case was reported but later tested negative.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #SriLanka

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
The Minister addressed misinformation in the media, clarifying that previous comments by immunologist Prof. Neelika Malavige about an older case were misrepresented. 
He called for responsible reporting on sensitive health issues and noted that the Epidemiology Unit is actively updating the Health Ministry, with the President showing special concern about the situation.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #SriLanka

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
Sri Lanka has not identified any current #HMPV cases and has established extensive monitoring and testing measures. 
Authorities remain alert and committed to ensuring public health safety while addressing misinformation about the virus.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #SriLanka
